long_biography.plain_text:
Curchod Fils brought Yves Augustin Aellen into its governance in 2009. Ten years later he moved into the company's top board post. Based in Plan-les-Ouates, the long-established contractor provides sanitary and heating installations, plumbing, metalwork, maintenance, emergency response and technical studies.

At the same address, Rutsch broadens the operating footprint into industrial pipework, prefabrication, roof construction and waterproofing. Aellen presides over this second board as well, while appointed directors separately manage daily operations at each business. Jessica Nancy Aellen holds parallel appointments as a Curchod director and Rutsch board member.

uncertainties.detail: The source record is the only direct assertion connecting Yves Aellen to Alligator. The yacht carries a Swiss flag, and the Vandoeuvres namesake is the only exact-name commercial-register match with a separate marine-company connection, but public yacht sources do not publish an owner. The dossier therefore resolves to the Vandoeuvres businessman at high, not very-high, confidence.

A distinct Yves Aellen in Duebendorf founded and manages Nextonic GmbH and uses the exact LinkedIn URL found during research. His consultancy career, education and social profile are excluded from this dossier.

The Manege de La Pallanterie history names an Yves and Antoinette Aellen as its 2007 operators, but current corporate material points to an Yves Aellen with a different place of origin and residence. Without a stronger bridge, no equestrian biography fact or tag is transferred.

A public Geneva planning document reproducing official land records gives Yves Augustin Aellen's birth date as 6 July 1949. The full-name and property context fit the Vandoeuvres businessman, but the match remains indirect because no company or yacht source publishes his date of birth.

Jessica Nancy Aellen serves on both company boards and shares Aellen's Vandoeuvres register context. No reliable source reviewed states their relationship, documents a family transfer or identifies her as his successor, so the dossier makes none of those claims.

Board presidencies and signing authority establish an operating relationship, not beneficial ownership or the source of Aellen's wealth. Wealth creation and origin therefore remain Unknown; Construction & Engineering is used only for his principal documented current business activity.

The approved active catalogue contains no precise plumbing or building-services tag. Equestrian sport is not assigned because that identity strand is unresolved, and a broad construction-materials tag would misstate the contractors' service activities.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website was verified for the Vandoeuvres businessman. The exact-name LinkedIn belongs to the Duebendorf namesake and is excluded. Only Rutsch's verified company website is proposed.

Research reached a terminal but limited conclusion. The owner is resolved to the Vandoeuvres Yves Augustin Aellen through the source record, Swiss yacht context, exact-name register separation and his separate GM Marine connection. Current Curchod Fils and Rutsch presidencies support a concise biography and an Operator relationship, while public evidence does not support founder, heir, owner or personal-fortune claims. No shared state or input was changed.
